result.guidanceOfficial: Looking to the remainder of the year, there are even more exciting films ahead, with the holiday movie slate featuring several franchise-driven tentpole films that are expected to appeal to a wide range of audiences. The historic World Series run for the Milwaukee Brewers, along with upcoming holiday travel and events, also bode well for our hotels business as we round out the year.
